# Klintskalni 1

> Two seaside holiday homes for rent on one property near Tūja beach in Liepupe
> parish, Limbaži Municipality, Latvia, on the Gulf of Riga coast. Rent one unit
> or both together.

## The homes
- The House — sleeps 8, 3 bedrooms, 5 beds, 1.5 baths. Book on Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.no/rooms/1028053261687651967
- The Cottage — sleeps 7, 3 bedrooms, 4 beds, 1 bath. Book on Airbnb: https://www.airbnb.no/rooms/1033329284775400298

## Location & features
- Liepupe parish, near Tūja, Limbaži Municipality, Latvia (Gulf of Riga / Vidzeme coast).
- Direct access to a long sandy beach.
- Shared garden with playground, sports area and a wood-fired sauna. Pets welcome.
- Both units can be rented together on request (contact directly).

## Site
- Website: https://klintskalni.pages.dev (English /en/, Norsk /no/, Latviešu /lv/)
- Booking: via the Airbnb links above, or by email.
